title: Klonoa 2: Dream Champ Tournament
subtitle: A tournament turns movement into a contest
summary: Klonoa 2: Dream Champ Tournament is Now Production's Game Boy Advance puzzle platformer following Klonoa into a competition between adventurers. Its small stages continue the handheld series' emphasis on catching enemies and using them to solve spatial problems. The tournament setting adds rival competitors and races to the journey, giving familiar movements another context. Each vision contains the stars needed to open its exit, while optional discoveries encourage more careful exploration. A successful route depends on using what the stage provides rather than simply finding enough speed to run past its obstacles.
body: Klonoa 2: Dream Champ Tournament is Now Production's Game Boy Advance puzzle platformer following Klonoa into a competition between adventurers. Its small stages continue the handheld series' emphasis on catching enemies and using them to solve spatial problems. The tournament setting adds rival competitors and races to the journey, giving familiar movements another context. Each vision contains the stars needed to open its exit, while optional discoveries encourage more careful exploration. A successful route depends on using what the stage provides rather than simply finding enough speed to run past its obstacles.

The Wind Bullet draws an enemy toward Klonoa so that he can hold it overhead. Throwing it can clear another opponent, while using it for a double jump trades that object for extra height. Brief hovering provides another small adjustment once he has left the ground. These actions turn the inhabitants of a stage into parts of its route. The player must decide which creature should be carried forward and where to spend its usefulness, especially when several stars require different approaches to the same group of platforms and obstacles.

The adventure is organised into worlds whose visions include races against another competitor while a boss encounter unfolds. Special stages also place Klonoa on a hoverboard, changing the immediate movement while retaining the task of avoiding hazards. Dream Shards and Sun Stones give optional goals beyond the three stars needed for the exit. These variations extend the compact puzzle stages without discarding their central abilities. The tournament supplies a reason for the different tests to follow one another, while each new arrangement asks how well the player understands Klonoa's available movements.
